messages:
anna: Hey team — I'm opening a small Terraform change to add a private subnet for the analytics batch workers in us-west-2 (single AZ for now). Want a quick routing/privatelink sanity check before I merge.

anna: Key goals: keep egress via existing NATGW, attach to analytics RT (no internet route), and create a VPC endpoint for our internal-metrics API (interface endpoint).

anna: Diff excerpt:
```hcl
resource "aws_subnet" "analytics_private_a" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block        = cidrsubnet(var.private_cidr, 4, 6)
  availability_zone = "us-west-2a"
  tags = { Name = "analytics-private-a" }
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "metrics_endpoint" {
  vpc_id            = var.vpc_id
  service_name      = data.aws_vpc_endpoint_service.metrics.service_name
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Interface"
  subnet_ids        = [aws_subnet.analytics_private_a.id]
  private_dns_enabled = true
}
```

sahil: quick q — is the analytics RT already created or are you adding a new route table + assoc? Also need to ensure we don't add a 0.0.0.0/0 to the RT.

anna: good call. I'm reusing the existing "private-analytics-rt" that already points default to natgw in the same AZ. No 0.0.0.0/0 addition.

marta: CI might flag interface endpoint ENI count. Can you add the endpoint to the same subnet AZ to avoid cross-AZ ENIs? Also tag the endpoint with project=analytics.

anna: will do tags and keep it AZ-local. One more: do we need a security group change? The metrics endpoint needs inbound from the analytics SG on 443.

luis: You can reference the analytics SG by id in the endpoint. If the SG is in another account, remember to allow endpoint service principal. But ours is same account.

anna: thanks — updated plan: add SG rule, tags, endpoint in same AZ. I'll push a follow-up commit.

infra-ci-bot: plan finished — No changes to existing NATGW or TGW attachments. Proposed: +1 subnet, +1 vpc_endpoint, +1 sg_rule. (link: https://ci.internal/redwood/plan/3829) :white_check_mark:

sahil: quick review: please include lifecycle ignore_changes for endpoint network_interface_ids to avoid noisy diffs from AWS. Also add terraform fmt/validate.

anna: noted — adding lifecycle and running fmt. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4521

marta: I'll do a quick approval after CI passes. lgtm on the networking bits.

luis: ping me if you want me to run the canary in staging for routing e2e.

anna: thanks all — merging after CI and marta's approval.
